name: ecommerce-harness-plugin-for-jianheng
title_zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 插上电商履约手
tagline_zh: 不用重写底层，就能让 Harness 跑通下单、库存、支付回调。适合已有 Harness 但缺电商动作的团队。
tagline_en: Add order, stock, and payment actions to DeepSeek Harness without rewriting core. For teams that need e-commerce.
desc_en: 基于DeepSeek Harness开发的第三方插件
why_zh: 它不替代 Harness，而是按官方扩展点挂接，把电商领域动作封装成插件，让主框架保持干净，升级不冲突。
why_en: It extends Harness via official hooks, packaging e-commerce actions as a plugin—keeping the core clean and upgrade-safe.
limit_zh: 只适配 DeepSeek Harness 的既有版本，不附带 Harness 本体；电商动作仅覆盖下单、库存。
limit_en: Only for existing DeepSeek Harness versions; no core included. Covers order, stock, payment callback only—extend for more.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: E-commerce harness plugin for DeepSeek Harness
